claim: graduated/ candidate JSON files under .agent/memory/candidates/graduated/ are the PERMANENT audit trail (reviewer, rationale, timestamp) once mark_graduated() moves them there -- there is no sanctioned prune/archive path, so a branch that deletes them did so by mistake, not legitimate cleanup

decisions.notes: Nearly replayed a 5-file deletion from an abandoned branch (pr260-work) as 'trivial post-graduation cleanup' before checking .agent/memory/review_state.py's mark_graduated() implementation and confirming graduated/ is a permanent destination, not a temp holding pen. archive.py only handles stale WORKSPACE.md files, unrelated. Caught before committing; restored the files instead of replaying the deletion.
